description: Defines a data transfer object (DTO) 'QuoteRequest' with nested records for destination and items, used for shipping rate quote requests. Includes validation annotations and schema documentation.

classes.name: QuoteRequest
classes.description: Record representing a shipping quote request, including destination, currency, and items.

classes.name: QuoteRequest.Destination
classes.description: Nested record containing destination address details such as country, postal code, and region.

classes.name: QuoteRequest.Item
classes.description: Nested record representing an individual item with SKU, quantity, and weight.
